south.board.trail.title: The Aton Trail
south.board.trail.1: From the Aton station on the headland, the trail follows the ridge down into the valley.
south.board.trail.2: The descent is gentle, but slippery after rain.
south.board.trail.3: A brook runs at the bottom; a spring of clear water is further up the valley.
south.board.trail.4: In the reedbed by the brook's mouth, starlings gather at dusk.
south.board.reeds.title: The reedbed. Quiet: birds
south.board.reeds.1: Reed warblers nest here in summer.
south.board.reeds.2: At dusk starlings fly in to roost, sometimes in their thousands.
south.board.reeds.4: Do not leave the boardwalk: there are nests in the reeds and the ground is soft.
